QUOTE: `_loader.py` finds `librentropic.so` in this order: `$ENTROPIC_LIB`, then `$ENTROPIC_HOME` (nested, then flat layout), then `~/.entropic`, then `ctypes.util.find_library`.
VERDICT: MISS
WHY: The answer gives env overrides, a default user dir, and the system lookup, but it applies the two layouts (nested, flat) only to `$ENTROPIC_HOME`, not to each root, so "two layouts per root" is missing.
